items.title: The extension by zero along a quasi-compact open immersion commutes with limits
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a quasi-compact open immersion j : U -> X the extension by zero on the pro-etale sites commutes with limits (statement lines 5401-5407). The proof (proof lines 5409-5428) reduces to the commutation with products and to an affine base, expresses the extension by zero as the kernel of a map between functors commuting with products, and concludes by the exactness of products on the pro-etale site. H2: a three-step reduction with three inputs, written out in full.
